description: Use when you need a Canadian settlement date or accrual fraction. Rolls a trade date forward on the Payments Canada calendar and counts the accrual under ACT/360, ACT/365F, 30/360, 30E/360 or ACT/ACT-ISDA. $0.01 USDC on Base per answer via x402; a refusal is free.

accrual_start.description: a real calendar date, the first day of the accrual period, counted

trade_date.description: a business day on the calendar
